governance_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md: Roles (maintainer, contributor, reporter) and How decisions are made; the one maintainer is named there (@jeancarlos)
roles_responsibilities_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md: Roles (maintainer, contributor, reporter) and How decisions are made; the one maintainer is named there (@jeancarlos)

access_continuity_justification: One person (the maintainer, https://github.com/jeancarlos) holds admin access to the repository, the release workflow and the DNS zone; no second person can release or merge within a week. https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md says so in its Continuity section and leaves the backup maintainer as an open TODO
bus_factor_justification: Bus factor is 1: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/graphs/contributors shows one human author with every merged change; https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md states the project has one maintainer and will invite a trusted contributor when one appears
documentation_roadmap_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md: Now, Next, Later and Not planned, covering the twelve months to October 2027
documentation_architecture_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (components, data flow, key properties, deployment) and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md section How it's built (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#how-its-built)
documentation_security_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md: Security requirements (what the bot protects and what users can expect), linked from https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/SECURITY.md
documentation_quick_start_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md section Install (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#install): one `curl ... | sh` command, the installer pairs WhatsApp on screen; Run your own (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#run-your-own) for the manual route
documentation_current_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/test/docs.test.ts fails CI when a doc points to a missing npm script, path or relative link; docs/ASSURANCE.md must change in the same pull request as a trust boundary (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-makes-a-contribution-acceptable); the README, ROADMAP and CHANGELOG (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) are updated with each release
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md front page links the CI, security, CodeQL and OpenSSF Scorecard badges (https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot); the Best Practices badge will be added to the README when the project id exists
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: the product is a text chat bot with no GUI of its own, and the only web page is a static one-page site (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/site/index.html, lang set, semantic HTML) with no interactive content
internationalization_justification: Every user-facing string is in message tables for Portuguese, English and Spanish, selectable at install: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/core/i18n.ts and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/setup/i18n.ts; https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md invites more languages
maintenance_or_update_justification: Only the latest release is supported (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/SECURITY.md); the upgrade path is one command, `contas-bot update` or the install one-liner, which keeps settings, history and the WhatsApp session (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#day-to-day), and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#coming-from-1x covers the 1.x migration
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: no vulnerability report has been resolved in the last 12 months (no advisories at https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/security/advisories); https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/SECURITY.md Process step 4 promises credit in the advisory and release notes
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/SECURITY.md Process: acknowledge in 7 days, confirm or reject in 14, fix on a private branch, patch release, GitHub security advisory, CVE in the release notes, reporter credited; reports come through https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/security/advisories/new
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#style: Biome decides formatting and lint, configured in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/biome.json, with TypeScript strict checking in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/tsconfig.json
coding_standards_enforced_justification: `npm run lint` (`biome check --error-on-warnings`) and `tsc --noEmit` run in the `test` job of https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and in the pre-commit hook; the `test` check is required on develop and main (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/settings/branches)
build_standard_variables_justification: no native binaries and no build system: TypeScript runs directly on Node (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json has no build script); the container image is built by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/Dockerfile
build_preserve_debug_justification: no native binaries and no build system: TypeScript runs directly on Node (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json has no build script); the container image is built by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/Dockerfile
build_non_recursive_justification: no native binaries and no build system: TypeScript runs directly on Node (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json has no build script); the container image is built by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/Dockerfile
build_repeatable_justification: no compile step, the source is what runs (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json); the one generated release file, install.sh, is https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/install.sh with the version substituted by `sed` in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml, and its provenance attestation is verifiable from the release (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/releases/latest)
build_reproducible_justification: no compile step, the source is what runs (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json); the one generated release file, install.sh, is https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/install.sh with the version substituted by `sed` in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml, and its provenance attestation is verifiable from the release (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/releases/latest)
installation_common_justification: installed with a container in a standard format and one script, https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/install.sh (GHCR image from https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/Dockerfile), uninstalled with `docker compose down && rm -rf ~/contas-bot` (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#uninstall)
installation_standard_variables_justific: nothing is installed into system paths: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/install.sh writes only under `~/contas-bot`, or `CONTAS_BOT_DIR` when set (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#install), so DESTDIR conventions do not apply
installation_development_quick_justifica: `npm ci` then `npm run check` (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-setup); dependencies are fixed by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package-lock.json
external_dependencies_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package-lock.json (npm); base image and actions pinned by digest or SHA in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/Dockerfile and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot for npm, GitHub Actions and Docker (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml), plus OSV-Scanner on the lockfile and Trivy on the image every week and on every change (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml)
updateable_reused_components_justificati: all third-party code comes from npm through https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package-lock.json, with no vendored copies; updating one is a Dependabot pull request (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml)
interfaces_current_justification: targets the current Node 22 LTS with built-in `node:sqlite`, `node:test` and native TypeScript (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json); https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md schedules the move to the next LTS before Node 22 end of life
automated_integration_testing_justificat: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs `npm run check` on every push to develop and every pull request, and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml reports coverage; results at https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/actions
regression_tests_added50_justification: every `fix` commit must change something under test/ or carry a reasoned `No-Test:` line, enforced by the commit hook and the `fixes-have-tests` job (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/scripts/test-policy.ts, https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests-are-required)
test_statement_coverage80_justification: `npm run coverage` (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json) uses Node's built-in coverage and fails below 90 percent lines; the current run reports 91 percent lines; enforced by the `coverage` job in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml
test_statement_coverage90_justification: `npm run coverage` (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json) uses Node's built-in coverage and fails below 90 percent lines; the current run reports 91 percent lines; enforced by the `coverage` job in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml
test_branch_coverage80_justification: the same `npm run coverage` gate fails below 93 percent branches (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/package.json); the current run reports 94 percent branches, enforced in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml
test_policy_mandated_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests-are-required: every new behavior and bug fix needs a test in test/, enforced by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/scripts/test-policy.ts
implement_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md Secure design principles applied (least privilege, economy of mechanism, fail safe, complete mediation, separation of secrets); the container limits are in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docker-compose.yml
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: the project implements no cryptographic algorithm; it uses Node's TLS and WhatsApp's protocol through Baileys (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md, No custom cryptography)
crypto_credential_agility_justification: the LLM key and bot settings live in `.env` and the WhatsApp session in `auth/`, both outside the image and the code, and change without rebuilding (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docker-compose.yml, https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.env.example, https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md)
crypto_used_network_justification: WhatsApp traffic is encrypted by Baileys and the LLM endpoint defaults to HTTPS providers (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#install); the only plain HTTP is the optional add-on server, off unless `HTTP_PORT` is set (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/addons/README.md); Node 22 negotiates TLS 1.2 or later by default and the code never lowers it
crypto_tls12_justification: WhatsApp traffic is encrypted by Baileys and the LLM endpoint defaults to HTTPS providers (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/README.md#install); the only plain HTTP is the optional add-on server, off unless `HTTP_PORT` is set (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/addons/README.md); Node 22 negotiates TLS 1.2 or later by default and the code never lowers it
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: outgoing HTTPS uses Node's default verification and no code disables it (no `rejectUnauthorized: false` anywhere in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/tree/main/src; https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md Bot to LLM endpoint)
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: outgoing HTTPS uses Node's default verification and no code disables it (no `rejectUnauthorized: false` anywhere in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/tree/main/src; https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md Bot to LLM endpoint)
signed_releases_justification: every release asset and the container image carry a Sigstore build provenance attestation made by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml with no stored private key; users verify with `gh attestation verify` as documented in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-release; assets at https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/releases/latest
version_tags_signed_justification: release tags are annotated but not GPG or SSH signed; releases are signed through Sigstore attestations instead (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-release)
input_validation_justification: allowlists everywhere input enters: group allowlist and size caps (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md), month and port patterns in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/adapters/http.ts, strict JSON validation of model output in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/llm.ts, parsed amounts in https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/core/money.ts; fuzzed by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/test/core/fuzz.test.ts
hardening_justification: HTTP add-on replies carry a Content-Security-Policy of `default-src 'none'` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/adapters/http.ts); the container drops all capabilities, runs read-only as non-root with `no-new-privileges` and memory and process limits (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docker-compose.yml); workflow permissions are least privilege and actions are pinned by SHA (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml)
assurance_case_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md: threat model and trust boundaries table, secure design principles, common weaknesses and how they are countered, assurance activities
contributors_unassociated_justification: the project has one human contributor (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/graphs/contributors); the other authors are Dependabot and GitHub Actions
copyright_per_file_justification: every tracked source file starts with `SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later` and a `Copyright (C) 2026 Jean Souza` line, enforced by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/test/licenses.test.ts (for example https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/shell/index.ts)
license_per_file_justification: every tracked source file starts with `SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later` and a `Copyright (C) 2026 Jean Souza` line, enforced by https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/test/licenses.test.ts (for example https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/src/shell/index.ts)
small_tasks_justification: issues labelled good first issue (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/labels/good%20first%20issue), e.g. https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/issues/84, https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/issues/85 and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/issues/86, pointed to from https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#where-to-start and https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md
require_2FA_justification: the maintainer's GitHub two-factor setting cannot be verified from the repository or its API, and the project has no organization policy requiring it; to be updated once it is confirmed at https://github.com/settings/security
secure_2FA_justification: the maintainer's GitHub two-factor setting cannot be verified from the repository or its API, and the project has no organization policy requiring it; to be updated once it is confirmed at https://github.com/settings/security
code_review_standards_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review: how review is done, the checklist of what must be checked and what makes a change acceptable (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-makes-a-contribution-acceptable); pull request template https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
two_person_review_justification: the project has one maintainer, who reviews their own pull requests (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review); branch protection requires zero approvals (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/settings/branches); outside contributions are reviewed by the maintainer
hardened_site_justification: the repository on github.com is hosted by GitHub, which is known to meet this, but the project site (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/site/index.html at https://contas-bot.jeansouza.dev) is served by GitHub Pages, which does not let the project set CSP, HSTS or X-Frame-Options
security_review_justification: only a tool-assisted audit was done in October 2026 (https://github.com/jeancarlos/contas-bot/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md Assurance activities); no human security review against the security requirements and boundaries has been recorded
